briefdescription.para: XilNvm capability bits in Xil_LibInfo.Capability[0] returned in the Features-command library-info response.

detaileddescription.para: Each enumerator is a bit position. Do not reorder.

Key types from XNVM_EFUSE_AES_KEY_2ND onwards address the independent secondary eFUSE slots of Versal_2Ve_2Vm and Versal_2Vp_P. The server routes every key type at or above that value to the platform layer, so these values must stay last.

briefdescription.para: API ids, IDs ranging from an enum value of 24 to 35 are used by IPI.
Number of offchip revocation ID eFuses.
PPK hash length in bytes for Versal, VersalNet and Versal_2vp.
CRC value for all zero key.
